claim_ceiling: Cases exercise configuration and transition logic only. They do not establish physical changeover time, production readiness, safety clearance, machine qualification, operator qualification or factory performance.

evaluator_contract.success_meaning: Structurally feasible for qualification only; production_authorized must remain false.
evaluator_contract.physical_change_rule: Physical module, connection, placement, layout or coordinate-frame changes create independent requalification obligations.
evaluator_contract.soft_change_rule: Operation reassignment without physical or layout changes is AllocationOnly and retains the current physical installation; process/workforce/inspection obligations remain explicit.
evaluator_contract.missing_fact_rule: Missing in a Complete source pool is Blocked; missing in Partial/Unknown is Indeterminate.
evaluator_contract.evidence_rule: Expired or revoked evidence is Blocked; missing, unknown, issuerless or validity-unresolved evidence is Indeterminate.

cases.name: Initial qualified module composition
cases.reason: Initial assembly can be planned but still requires physical commissioning and independent requalification.

cases.name: Unchanged current configuration
cases.reason: No transition is needed when the qualified physical and allocation state is unchanged.

cases.name: Soft operation reassignment
cases.reason: Demand changes should be handled in software before moving equipment when a qualified installed alternative exists.

cases.name: Add a qualified module
cases.reason: New physical module installation requires interface inspection, layout validation and independent commissioning.

cases.name: Relocate a qualified module
cases.reason: Relocation changes geometry and invalidates the installed cell qualification context.

cases.name: Expired module profile
cases.reason: A module with expired qualification cannot enter a target configuration.

cases.name: Revoked module qualification evidence
cases.reason: Revoked evidence blocks module use even when its profile status still says Qualified.

cases.name: Process parameter digest drift
cases.reason: A process parameter change cannot reuse capability qualification bound to another digest.

cases.name: Port protocol mismatch
cases.reason: Modules cannot be composed across an interface protocol mismatch.

cases.name: Port unit mismatch
cases.reason: Numeric capacity is not comparable across incompatible units.

cases.name: Port capacity exceeded
cases.reason: A physically connectable interface can still be undersized for the required process flow.

cases.name: Required port left unconnected
cases.reason: A complete target configuration cannot omit a required process/service interface.

cases.name: Module footprint collision
cases.reason: Target module footprints cannot occupy the same declared physical area.

cases.name: Module intersects keepout
cases.reason: Declared keepout regions are hard geometry constraints; this does not replace formal egress or safety review.

cases.name: Coordinate-frame mismatch
cases.reason: Coordinates from different spatial frames cannot be composed without an explicit evidenced transform.

cases.name: Partner module reused at another facility
cases.reason: Module qualification is site-scoped and cannot be silently transferred to another facility.

cases.name: Module profile unresolved in partial pool
cases.reason: Unresolved owner data cannot be treated as module absence or availability.

cases.name: Module profile absent from complete pool
cases.reason: The complete owner snapshot establishes that no matching qualified module profile was supplied.

cases.name: Commissioning evidence missing for unchanged cell
cases.reason: An unchanged physical installation still requires current commissioning evidence to remain in service.

cases.name: Layout revision changes without module movement
cases.reason: A changed layout context requires review and requalification even if module coordinates happen to remain numerically identical.

cases.name: Assignment removed
cases.reason: The transition report must explicitly unassign work removed from the required route without forcing a physical module move.

publication_requirements: Publish exact module/profile/configuration revisions and input digest.
Separate allocation-only changes from physical transitions.
Count qualification obligations and independent review steps.
Never compare a synthetic transition estimate to physical changeover time.
Report all blocked and indeterminate cases; do not filter them from optimizer metrics.
